# `ecommerce_item_product_exists`

> Every line sells a product of the catalog; unknown SKUs can't be priced or categorised.

| | |
|---|---|
| Domain | [ecommerce](README.md) |
| Layer | **silver** — evaluated by the `silver` gate |
| Model | `slv_ecommerce__order_items` (`ecommerce_silver.slv_ecommerce__order_items`) |
| Column | `sku` |
| Check | `relationships` |
| Severity | `error` — a violation **stops the pipeline** |
| Defined in | [dbt/models/ecommerce/silver/_silver.yml](../../../dbt/models/ecommerce/silver/_silver.yml) |

## What it checks

Every `sku` exists as `sku` in `slv_ecommerce__products`.

## When it fails

The `silver` task of `medallion_ecommerce` fails, gold and `publish_gold` don't run, and the batch is never added to `ecommerce_gold`: consumers keep the batches published before. `quality_report` marks the run as blocked and sends the alert, if one is configured.

The rows that broke the rule in its latest evaluation are kept in `dq_audit.ecommerce_item_product_exists`.

## Tested by

Scenario **`unknown_sku`**: order lines for a product not in the catalog.

```bash
make generate DOMAIN=ecommerce SCENARIO=unknown_sku BATCH=2026-10-20_unknown_sku
make pipeline DOMAIN=ecommerce BATCH=2026-10-20_unknown_sku
```
